note: Precommitted before scoring. #53 REQUIRES every withheld retention class to fail closed at load. Whether the system meets that requirement is measured, not assumed here: a class that fails open is recorded as a FINDING and never as a pass, and never as a failure of the harness either.
sl1_per_member_source: SL1-G6B Family B measured +16,704 bytes (+1.88%) for ONE declared-patchable member on the g4_host_solo shape, and stated that the number must not be multiplied naively. This gate tests that statement.
cause_vocabulary_source: SL1's classifier in semantic_linker/runtime_feasibility/g6a_negatives/run_negatives.sh, patterns reused verbatim. #53 requires this gate to reuse that vocabulary.
acceptance_requires: every class in must_fail_closed observed FAILS_CLOSED. checks_failed=0 establishes only that the experiment is trustworthy; it is not a pass.
disposition: completed measurement; limitation carried forward to G5/G6. The two runtime fail-open classes do NOT trigger compiler or runtime work inside G4, and #53's requirement is NOT rewritten as satisfied.

carried_forward.G5: a predicted-patchable declaration requires ALL its required retention entries mechanically proven present in the exact release; a missing, stale or unproven entry REFUSES BEFORE PUBLICATION. Necessary because extendable and can-be-overridden cannot be relied on as runtime safety nets: omitted, the runtime loads the module and silently executes the old AOT body.
carried_forward.G6: bind that retention/map evidence to the exact release Kernel and AOT identity, so stale or swapped proof cannot satisfy G5.
carried_forward.G7: consume the accepted cost curve only: 40,912-byte floor + ~82 bytes per member on this measured shape.

can_be_used_as_type_note: stays conservatively REQUIRED wherever the retention contract requires it. NO_OBSERVABLE_EFFECT on this one shape is not evidence that the entry is unnecessary.
